_doc: Page errors that are real but known and tracked elsewhere. drive.js logs them as 'known' instead of failing the run. Each entry: pattern (regex on the error line), why (where it is tracked). Remove an entry once fixed.

issues.pattern: ^Fetch API cannot load http: ?/+127\.0\.0\.1:\d+/api/\S+ due to access control checks\.$
issues.why: WebKit (Playwright) reports a same-origin fetch that a reload or goto aborts (the long poll, push status) as a page error; Chromium stays quiet. Journeys that reload mid-run (detailclose.js) hit it. Not an app bug (t-detail-close End round).
